title: M³-AVM: Multimodal Multi-Model Abstract Virtual Machine
description: M³-AVM (Multimodal Multi-Model Abstract Virtual Machine) is a deterministic virtual machine prototype in Rust for sparse event-driven tensor computation. This deposit freezes ISA v1.4 (32-byte instructions: control/thinking loop 0x00-0x0F, GEMV 0x10-0x12, Mamba/SSM and audio codec 0x13-0x19, GATHER 0x1F / DISTANCE 0x23 / RANK1_UPDATE 0x24, KV_TRUNCATE 0x38, RNG/hash 0x60-0x66, telemetry/scheduler 0x6A-0x77, LOADI/MOV 0x78-0x79, NOP 0xFF), strict-priority scheduler (Red > Blue > Green) with absolute deadlines, CoW snapshot/rollback (FORK/ABORT) with monotonic version counter, CSR sparse tensors, Q4_K fused AVX2 matvec, GGUF mmap inference with per-layer KV cache, and Lean 4 proofs (SSM, rollback, windowed error). Cluster (0x1A-0x1D), universal-AI remainder (CONV/RAG/DEPFORMER/STREAM_MERGE/KV_TRANSFER), 64-byte forms and device-aware EDF scheduling are frozen/reserved future work, explicitly rejected at runtime — see docs/ESPEC.md (normative) and docs/ESPEC-V2.md (draft).
